bench-wiring.text: For the optional quantization bench only, the violet lead is wired to jack Q7; this hardware detail does not concern course organization or the theory of response and stability.

materials-orientation.text: Course overview lists Lumen lecture notes organised as response, stability and frequency; Atlas is a reference with longer derivations; lab sheets are laboratory questions. Available lab material is inconsistent about signal domain: current-lab-sheet says continuous-time with impulse response g(t), while lab-notice says discrete-time with impulse response g[n]. Learner reports lecturer uses g for impulse response and Atlas uses h; this notation correspondence has not been independently checked beyond lab sheets using g. Learner suspects response and stability are related views rather than separate modules and wants rough orientation, not a fixed curriculum, exercise or quiz. No learner understanding has been demonstrated yet.
